text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock A at a gain felt satisfying, but I should avoid trimming solely to lock in profit; weigh valuation, risk, and the position’s role in my portfolio.","Selling Stock E at a loss was painful, yet holding or selling should depend on its prospects and portfolio fit—not just whether it has recovered to my average cost.","My account value has swung despite selective trades, so I should judge decisions across the whole diversified portfolio and over a longer horizon, not by individual realized gains or one-month returns."]}
